events.title: FinCEN classifies virtual-currency activity under BSA rules
events.caveat: Distinguishes ordinary users from administrators/exchangers; not blanket approval or prohibition.
events.evidence_scope: Issued 2013-03-18. Interpretive BSA guidance covers convertible virtual currency; it differentiates users from administrators/exchangers, with limitations/exemptions for the latter. Locator: PDF p.1 opening and footnote 1; p.2 definitions and footnote 4 Scope: Direct agency guidance establishes its issuance and regulatory interpretation, not a finding that all virtual-currency activity is lawful or unlawful.

events.title: MtGox applies for civil rehabilitation in Tokyo
events.caveat: Application accepted that day; not a final liquidation judgment.
events.evidence_scope: Retained company announcement PDF p1 and p3 reports application accepted February 28, Tokyo District Court; company account, not underlying docket.

events.title: Ethereum Frontier launches
events.caveat: Separate network, not a Bitcoin upgrade.
events.evidence_scope: Dated 2015-07-30. Ethereum Foundation announcement says users generated and loaded the genesis block minutes earlier, initiating Frontier as the first live release. Locator: Heading/byline and opening paragraph Scope: Contemporaneous project announcement supports launch date; this review did not independently replay Ethereum genesis.

events.title: Bitcoin Cash split
events.caveat: Month supported in DOJ historical explanation; separate BCH asset, not more BTC.
events.evidence_scope: DOJ retrospective explanation supports August 2017 BCH fork at month precision; not independently reconstructed protocol history.

events.title: SegWit activation-height block 481824
events.caveat: Bitcoin Core v29.0 identifies mainnet SegWit height/hash; Blockstream supplied metadata. Header hash and encoded time were recomputed. No independent full-chain replay or physical-origin inference.
events.evidence_scope: Versioned mainnet parameters bind SegWit height and hash; retained header hash/time recomputed. Miner-assigned time, not wall-clock mining/location.
events.original_caveat: Miner-assigned header time; code mainnet activation height matched.

events.title: CME/CFE Bitcoin futures contracts self-certified
events.caveat: This is certification date, not trading launch or CFTC endorsement.
events.evidence_scope: 2017-12-01 self-certification by CME and CFE of bitcoin futures is explicit. Cantor separately self-certified binary options. Release treats trading launch as future and expressly denies Commission approval/endorsement. Locator: Release 7654-17, dated heading, opening paragraph, penultimate substantive paragraph Scope: Direct regulator statement about its self-certification process; not evidence of first trading or investor adoption.

events.title: MicroStrategy discloses initial treasury BTC purchase
events.caveat: Company assets, not CEO personal property or independently traced settlement.
events.evidence_scope: On 2020-08-11 MicroStrategy disclosed purchase of 21,454 BTC for $250.0 million inclusive of fees and expenses. Cover gives Delaware incorporation, separately from Virginia executive offices. Locator: 8-K cover; Item 8.01 first paragraph; Exhibit 99.1 opening Scope: Issuer-reported completed purchase. Disclosure date is established; settlement dates, counterparties and actual wallet ownership are not independently established.

events.title: Coinbase completes Nasdaq direct listing
events.caveat: Corporate equity listing, not network issuance. Filing says remote-first with no headquarters; no fabricated headquarters pin.
events.evidence_scope: Company states Class A shares completed direct listing and began Nasdaq Global Select trading on 2021-04-14. Remote-first/no headquarters is explicitly stated for the report period. Locator: 10-K Item 5; Note 1; Item 2 Properties; SEC filing index Scope: Issuer filing supports the historical listing and corporate facts; no independent exchange tape review. No-headquarters statement is historical, not a verified 2026 condition.

events.title: IMF reports Salvadoran Bitcoin Law took effect in September 2021
events.caveat: IMF-reported historical legal status; original law not inspected. Month precision only. Changed in 2025; no actual payment-use measure.
events.evidence_scope: IMF retrospective account supports month only; original Salvadoran law was not independently inspected.
events.original_caveat: Historical legal-tender milestone; changed in 2025. Legal status does not measure actual payment use.

events.title: Chinese agencies issue a dated virtual-currency notice

geography.scope: Mainland China regulatory scope; Hong Kong and Macao regimes not established by this source

events.caveat: Notice dated September 15, 2021 and published September 24. Physical signing not verified. Does not establish zero holdings/mining or identical Hong Kong/Macao rules.
events.evidence_scope: Document date is not independent proof of physical signing; CN legal scope needs mainland distinction.
events.original_caveat: Business activities and overseas exchanges serving domestic residents addressed; not a measured extinction of holdings or mining.

events.title: Block at Taproot minimum activation height 709632
events.caveat: Blockstream-reported height; header hash and encoded timestamp independently recomputed. Bitcoin Core parameters set minimum activation height 709632. Prior signaling lock-in and consensus activation were not independently reconstructed; May release was conditional.
events.evidence_scope: Code supplies a minimum activation height and conditional plan; retained single header authenticates hash/time, not the whole signaling/activation chain. Admit only the narrower block-height observation.
events.original_caveat: Miner-assigned block timestamp; May release forecast is not substituted for actual block date.

events.title: Ethereum completes Merge to proof-of-stake
events.caveat: Bitcoin did not switch to proof-of-stake.
events.evidence_scope: Project documentation explicitly dates Merge execution to 2022-09-15 and identifies transition from proof-of-work to proof-of-stake. Displayed page last update is 2026-05-15. Locator: When is it shipping? / What was The Merge?; page last-update label Scope: Retrospective project documentation; original publication date remains unknown. Not an independent consensus-state reconstruction.

events.title: SEC approves spot Bitcoin ETP listing/trading rules
events.caveat: Does not establish investor count or approval of bitcoin itself.
events.evidence_scope: SEC statement is dated 2024-01-10 despite URL suffix 011023. It reports approval of listing/trading spot bitcoin ETP shares and disclaims bitcoin endorsement. The actual Commission order independently confirms accelerated approval of the specified exchange-rule proposals on that date. Locator: Dated heading; opening; paragraphs limiting scope; final substantive paragraph; supplemental order pp.1,21-22 Scope: Statement is an official account; supplemental order is the operative approval instrument. Neither demonstrates first trading, investor count, blanket crypto approval or custody endorsement.

events.title: Bankman-Fried sentenced in FTX fraud case
events.caveat: Historical DOJ account. Current appeal status not researched; no attribution to unrelated crypto participants.
events.evidence_scope: DOJ release dated 2024-03-28 reports a sentence that day of 25 years; site footer says updated 2024-04-30. Locator: Dated heading; opening paragraphs identifying sentence and Judge Kaplan; update footer Scope: Government/prosecution account of a historical sentencing event, not underlying judgment acquisition or current appeal/disposition verification. Existing sentencing_reported stage is accurate.

events.title: Fourth subsidy-halving height 840000 reached
events.caveat: Mainnet 210,000-block interval; Blockstream-reported height 840000. Header hash and miner-assigned timestamp independently recomputed, not full-chain height validation. No price/adoption causation established.
events.evidence_scope: 210,000-block schedule and provider-reported height support the selected fourth-halving-height observation; header hash/time were recomputed without full-chain replay.
events.original_caveat: UTC header time; 210000-block interval. No claim this caused price or adoption changes.

events.title: MiCA asset-referenced/e-money-token titles apply
events.caveat: Titles III/IV generally apply June 30, 2024, with listed provisions already applying June 29, 2023 under Article 149(4). Individual authorizations/compliance not audited.
events.evidence_scope: Article 149(3) June 30 date is subject to earlier-applying provisions in Article 149(4).

events.title: MiCA general application date
events.caveat: Transitional and national implementation provisions remain relevant.
events.evidence_scope: Regulation dated 2023-05-31, published 2023-06-09; entry into force 2023-06-29. Article 149 sets Titles III/IV application 2024-06-30 and general application 2024-12-30, with listed provisions already applying 2023-06-29. Locator: OJ citation; Articles 149(1)-(4), 143; final signature date Scope: Operative EU text establishes these legislative milestones; not an audit of individual authorizations or compliance. Article 143 transitional exceptions must remain visible.

events.title: IMF approves El Salvador program after Bitcoin reforms
events.caveat: IMF approved the El Salvador program February 26, 2025. SV identifies borrower/program country. IMF reports prior acceptance/tax reforms; original amending decree and exact reform-effective date not verified.
events.evidence_scope: Primary for IMF approval; Salvadoran reform detail is an IMF report. SV is the program/borrower country, not location/jurisdiction of approval.
events.original_caveat: Press release says private acceptance voluntary and taxes USD-only. Original amending decree was inaccessible; exact reform-effective date not asserted.

events.title: US Strategic Bitcoin Reserve order issued
events.caveat: Direction to establish/accounts and capitalize with qualifying finally forfeited BTC, subject to exceptions. No verified total reserve balance.
events.evidence_scope: Independent official executive-order review confirms March 6, 2025 directive only; legal-government-review.md.

events.title: GENIUS Act enacted
events.caveat: Enactment does not mean every provision effective; section 20 trigger not resolved in this batch.
events.evidence_scope: Public Law 119-27 was approved 2025-07-18. Section 20 general effective trigger is earlier of 18 months after enactment or 120 days after primary federal payment-stablecoin regulators issue any implementing final regulations. Locator: PDF p.1 Act heading/date; p.48 section 20 and approval line Scope: Public law establishes enactment and the conditional timing rule. This review has not established whether regulations triggered the earlier date; current full effectiveness is HOLD if separately asserted.

metrics.definition: Provider counts user/machine-initiated ledger transactions, excluding coinbase transactions on Bitcoin.
limits: Transactions are not people or payments.
Batching can combine recipients; change/consolidation and inscriptions can create activity without adoption.
Exchange-internal and offchain transfers are not counted.
metrics.reproduce: Use pinned API URL and raw SHA in sources/coinmetrics-receipt.json; aggregate daily counts by sum.

metrics.definition: Unique addresses involved as recipient or originator of a ledger change within each daily interval.
limits: Addresses are not users, wallets or beneficial owners.
One person may control many addresses; custodians can represent many people.
Do not sum daily unique counts into monthly unique users.
metrics.reproduce: Monthly mean of daily counts is valid if labeled as such; true monthly uniques require a separate metric.

metrics.definition: Estimated daily mean Bitcoin hash rate derived from difficulty and block arrivals; not a direct census of hardware.
limits: Block randomness makes short windows noisy.
Use 30-day smoothing; measurement revisions can affect comparisons.
More hash power is not more owners or independent miners.
metrics.reproduce: For BTC provider formula is (BlkCnt/144)*DiffMean*((2^32/10^12)/600); divide TH/s by 1e6 for EH/s.

metrics.definition: Provider native-unit supply visible on ledger at interval end.
limits: Not liquid/free-float supply; lost keys and inaccessible holdings unresolved.
Dataset reports zero at genesis day; special-case issuance accounting requires reconciliation before interpreting launch values.
metrics.reproduce: Take last observed daily value per month; never sum supply snapshots.

limits: No country-level adoption, users, ownership, mining or node series was acquired.
Events are selected historical records, not a complete history or a measure of adoption.
Country areas indicate a documented jurisdiction or expressly qualified institutional context, never wallet location.
Schematic relationships carry their stated roles; co-occurrence does not prove causation or a hidden connection.
Historical reporting dates do not establish current holdings or current legal status.
